name: From Cart to Repeat Purchase
description: Observed cosmetics-store journeys, repeat purchasing, and a prospective cart experiment. October 2019-February 2020, UTC.

cards.name: All-cart episode conversion
cards.description: Purchase at/after cart within an observed episode. Denominator: all cart episodes, including those without a prior view. October-February; selected timestamp rule.

cards.name: BF-week buyers repeating by day 30
cards.description: First observed purchase Nov 25-Dec 1. Complete 60-day follow-up base used at both day 30 and day 60. Observational rate.

cards.name: 7-day cart-user baseline
cards.description: 72,498 / 277,852 mature users entering at their first eligible cart since November. Different unit and horizon from episode conversion; no treatment observed.

cards.name: Scenario: +1 pp (source units / 10k users)
cards.description: Additional positive purchase-event price units, assuming unchanged seven-day value per converted user. Not realized revenue, verified currency, profit, or ROI.

cards.name: Recorded views narrow to ordered purchases
cards.description: Episode counts; cart must follow a view and purchase must follow that cart. The funnel cart denominator differs from all-cart conversion.

cards.name: Purchases also occur outside the full chain
cards.description: Disjoint groups of purchase-containing episodes. Missing full chains do not establish tracking faults or user motives.

cards.name: Conversion by observed visitor history
cards.description: Cart episodes entering November-February. First means first observed, not proven new. 95% user-clustered intervals in the table below.

cards.name: High-price carts convert more often than low-price carts
cards.description: October-frozen price bands: 3.00 and 6.03 source units. Cart-entry price; November-February episodes. Unknown shown separately. Association, not a causal price effect.

cards.name: Segment denominators and descriptive 95% intervals
cards.description: Episode conversion with user-clustered uncertainty. Users can appear in more than one group; do not sum group users as unique people.

cards.name: Two planned contrasts: adjusted uncertainty
cards.description: Differences in percentage points. User covariance retained; Bonferroni 97.5% intervals and adjusted p-values for two prespecified comparisons.

cards.name: Calendar-month repurchasing: M1 and M2
cards.description: First observed purchase cohort. M1/M2 are calendar months, not 30/60 elapsed days. Blank/dash cells are NA due to incomplete follow-up, never zero.

cards.name: BF-week 60-day repeats trail earlier November weeks
cards.description: Four first-purchase cohorts; fixed complete 60-day populations. Each line is cumulative first repeat by cohort age. No causal promotion effect; pointwise endpoints below are not a confidence band.

cards.name: Weekly cohort sizes and descriptive 95% intervals
cards.description: 30/60-day outcomes share each cohort's complete 60-day denominator. Intervals copied from the validated analysis, not recalculated in Metabase.

cards.name: Planning sensitivity, not experiment results
cards.description: Historical traffic replay includes enrollment plus seven follow-up days. Primary +1 pp plan: 30,643 users/arm, 28 days total. Value assumes unchanged conditional mean; zero reference has no sample-size requirement.

text.text:
## From cart to repeat purchase
Observed journeys, customer segments and repeat purchasing. October 2019-February 2020, UTC. **The proposed experiment has not been run.**

### 1. Most cart episodes end without a later purchase
All-cart conversion is measured within an episode. The ordered funnel below additionally requires a prior view. October-February, UTC.

### 2. Cart conversion differs across observed segments
November-February cart episodes; October-frozen price bands. Associations, not causal effects. Counts and user-clustered intervals below.

### 3. Calendar-month repurchasing
M1 and M2 are separate calendar months after the first observed purchase. Empty cells mean **NA: follow-up unavailable**, never zero.

### 4. Black Friday and nearby weeks
Fixed complete 60-day populations. The KPI at right is BF-week repeat by day 30; neither filter changes this comparison.

### 5. Hypothesis to test: show full cost and fulfillment terms in the cart
Plan: +1 pp, 30,643 users per arm, 21 enrollment + 7 follow-up days. The value scenario assumes unchanged value among buyers; it is not observed revenue or profit.

**Source:** REES46 / Michael Kechinov, Kaggle cosmetics-store events. **Limits:** no order ID, quantity, verified currency, costs or checkout diagnostics. Purchase episodes are proxies. See the methodology for definitions and sensitivity checks.
